incident-bot: PagerDuty PAGER fired for inference-hotpath (P1) — queue length 12.4k, avg wait 120s, dropping tokens. PD incident: PD-9876
pagerduty: PD-9876 auto-notify sent. responders: eng-oncall
alex: acked PD-9876 — I'm on.
alex: initial triage: scale-controller failing to provision new nodes, logs show quota errors and `nodepool` API 403 quota_exceeded
lee: looking into cloud quotas now, CPU quota at 98% for region us-west1
sara: metrics — p50 latency 260ms, p95 4.1s, errors increased 0.5% over baseline. Customer impact: several 5xx spikes on a few tenants
alex: manual short-term plan: try scale up replicas of inference pods to soak requests while infra works quota. running:
```
kubectl scale deployment inference-hotpath --replicas=40 -n prod
``` 
alex: also toggling burst_pool flag for dedicated nodes (per runbook step 2)
sara: enabling prefix KV caching on top-consuming routes to reduce token regen
carlos: routing note — moving noisy tenants to low-memory model variant v2-micro temporarily
lee: submitted quota increase request to cloud support (ticket GCP-12345), asked for emergency bump. ETA ~15-20m
infra-run: infra oncall engaged, checking reserved capacity and spot pool. Suggest adding preemptible fallback pool
pagerduty: PD-9876 acknowledged by alex at 1782345695
alex: scale command returned: some pods pending due to insufficient nodes. HPA not effective until nodepool scales
sara: observability updated: queue length dipped to 9.8k after partial scale, avg wait 75s. still elevated
alex: starting rolling restart on a subset to pick up cache flags:
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-hotpath -n prod --selector=zone=west
```
lee: cloud team confirmed temporary quota bump applied for CPUs + GPUs in us-west1 (grant until 1782347000)
carlos: with routing + cache + manual scale, customer error rate dropping. Monitor for 30m
alex: assigning follow-ups: postmortem, check autoscaler backoff loops and quota retry logic. Scheduling incident review at 10:00 UTC
sara: noted — adding evals to track quality drift from fallback model
alex: will keep PD open until normalized. ping me if regressions :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PD-9876 still open — last update at 1782345735
alex: closing thread here, monitoring in #eng-oncall for 30m. Thanks team.
